conclusion: The reviewed enclosing control/source chain does not enable QR_PREFIX for coarse/fine closure propagation. QR_PREFIX is explicitly enabled later for distinct signal-prediction commands. A QR-enabled propagation replay adds a configuration difference and must not be labeled output-path-only equivalent.
scope: Read-only reconstruction from exact sealed controller/source; not a saved /proc environment snapshot. Native execution records omit environment.
